selection_rule: Frozen final candidate selected by bounded development comparison; no weekly competition reselection.
calendar_note: Official templates: week_start is Friday, 2026-07-10 through 2026-10-02.
submission_protocol: Fixed origin; no weekly revisions in competition.
grading: sMAPE(naive) - sMAPE(model), percentage points; exact points not inferred from overlapping bands.
limitations: Historical chronological backtest, not an untouched competition test.
Weekly updates are a separate deployment experiment, not fixed-origin submission scoring.
Report dates assumed to be availability dates; values older than 45 days excluded.
Contract scenarios excluded due to ambiguous same-date observations.
Intervals are empirical, dependent and regime-sensitive; coverage is measured, not guaranteed.
Official scoring scripts not supplied; no interim organizer scoring.
Forecast features end at last target observation.
model_decision: Incumbent retained because neither conservative blend passed all no-regression guards.
strategy_decision: No active rule passed the positive-P&L, stress and concentration guards; fixed zero positions.
evaluation_note: Historical development comparison, not an independent test. Trading profits are not guaranteed.
